"/><div class="caption">Kelly is raising her three children in the same community where she grew up.</div></div>
<div class="story">
<div class="section-kicker">The Waterford I believe we can be</div>
<h2>A district families actively choose.</h2>
<p>That starts with taking care of the families, students and staff who are already here. Kelly wants stronger connections between schools and community, more consistent ways for parents, teachers, staff and students to have a voice, and a school board that is visible in buildings and throughout Waterford.</p>
<p>She wants the district to ask why families leave, learn from their experiences and look for ways to earn their confidence back — while making sure students feel safe and supported, teachers feel heard and valued, and parents feel like true partners.</p>
<div class="quote">“My goal isn’t to tear down what we have. It’s to listen, learn what’s working, be willing to address what isn’t, and help move Waterford forward together.”</div>
</div>
</div></section>
<section class="white" id="ideas"><div class="wrap">
<div class="section-kicker">A fresh perspective</div><h2>Ideas Kelly wants to bring to the table.</h2>
<p class="lead">These are the practical ideas Kelly has been talking about during the campaign.</p>
<div class="ideas">
<div class="idea"><h3>Student voice, starting young</h3><p>Explore elementary student councils and leadership opportunities so younger students have a voice, too.</p></div>
<div class="idea"><h3>Ask why families are leaving</h3><p>Use exit surveys or interviews to understand why families leave Waterford and what could have made them stay.</p></div>
<div class="idea"><h3>Focus on retention</h3><p>Bringing families in matters, but keeping the students and families already here matters just as much.</p></div>
<div class="idea"><h3>Consistency across Waterford</h3><p>Work toward strong opportunities and support regardless of which school a student attends.</p></div>
<div class="idea"><h3>More transparency</h3><p>Make Board discussions and decisions easier for the community to follow, including greater access to meeting recordings.</p></div>
<div class="idea"><h3>A visible school board</h3><p>Get Board members out of the boardroom and into schools, PTO meetings, events and the community.</p></div>
<div class="idea"><h3>Connect our PTOs</h3><p>Create more opportunities for PTOs across the district to share ideas, resources and what’s working.</p></div>
<div class="idea"><h3>Schools + local businesses</h3><p>Build partnerships that create mentorships, career exposure and opportunities for students.</p></div>
<div class="idea"><h3>Address bullying early</h3><p>Protect students being targeted while intervening with repeated behavior before it becomes a bigger pattern.</p></div>
<div class="idea"><h3>Learn from other districts</h3><p>Look at what surrounding districts are doing successfully and bring good ideas back to Waterford.</p></div>
</div>
</div></section>
